result.summary: The page appears mostly functional, with one notable visual issue identified.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') has its name text clipped mid-word ('Piccol') not at the screen edge but within what appears to be a complete card boundary, suggesting the text label itself is being truncated without an ellipsis, making it unclear what the restaurant name is.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis and overflow: hidden with a fixed width to restaurant name labels to ensure truncated text ends with '...' rather than cutting off mid-word.
